description: Run any model on the live WaveSpeed catalog: image, video, audio, 3D.
name: ai.wavespeed/mcp

environmentVariables.description: WaveSpeed API key (https://wavespeed.ai/accesskey). Optional when the wavespeed CLI is logged in.
environmentVariables.name: WAVESPEED_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Override the WaveSpeed API base URL. Defaults to https://api.wavespeed.ai.
environmentVariables.name: WAVESPEED_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Override the client name reported for channel attribution. Defaults to wavespeed-mcp.
environmentVariables.name: WAVESPEED_CLIENT_NAME
